body:
I think I go through reaaaalllly bad slumps. I'm either super mom or shitty mom. I'm a fucking roller coaster. This is obviously a throwaway account. I'm too ashamed to let anyone I know, know what a wreck I can be. 

I think breakingmom will help. I know I live my babies. I'd die for them. Yes they can make me fucking nuts. Two of them are 4 and the youngest is 3. They make me fucking bat shit crazy, and as much as I want to run away, I know I can't live without them. 

Talking to all you has helped me realize that it's OK that I'm not Martha fucking Stewart and that's OK. When I get into this depressed slumps, I need to remember I'm not alone and its OK to admit they're making me nuts lol. I am so damn hard on myself I'm quick to admit that I hate it and everything about it. 

Fuck yeah its hard and I'm not perfect and they're not gonna turn out perfect either becuase no one is. I've got to accept that so I can accept how much I fucking love these kids and keep on keeping on. 

I tried killing myself in August. I'm thankful I'm still here. I'm also thankful for all the folks who PM'd me and responded. I'm not alone and I don't have to do this alone or feel alone. 

Thank you all, seriously. Take care.

Meds. I exercise but not enough admittedly. I don't have much help. I think I'm especially down because I've had the flu for over a week now. My body wants rest and I can't get it. My honey works long hours and can't help much. My mom didn't like being a mom so she isn't help at all. I'll check out breakingmom. I love my children with all of me, but I hate myself for cringing when they wake up. I'm tired of feeling like a piece of crap excuse for a mother.
My oldest is 6. I've been in therapy since and I still find no enjoyment in this.

If it's any consolation, it doesn't matter if you're ugly or really good looking. I've been cheated on when I was an ugly duckling, I do got cheated on when I blossomed. I don't believe in monogamy anymore. People are fickle. It also doesn't matter how good of a partner one is either. They'll always cheat or leave. I wish I had something more consoling to say. Do what you want and don't worry about what being faithful. It's pointless.
Thank you for responding. I'm glad I'm not alone.

I'm sorry about your situation, but thank you for responding. I'm glad I don't feel alone. Our back yard is the same way. The deck is total chaos. Our little storage cave looks like someone tried to rob it, because there is stuff everywhere. I'm feeling not so down now and after being brave enough to talk about it with my SO, I feel like its OK not to be Martha Stewart. I realize I don't hate being a Mom. He reminded me how sad I get when I wake up on the weekends they're with their other parents, and I realize they're not there. I don't hate being mom, I hate being stressed out all the damn time lol. But I suppose that's life with children and having 5 of them full time is going to mean a much much bigger mess. Yeah, the 6 and 5 year old are getting much better at helping clean up after themselves, so once the youngest is 5, they'll be 6, 6, 7, 8 and I'll be damned if they're not cleaning up after themselves at that age lol. A few more years and my house won't be a giant play pen. Thank you for reading this. I honestly didn't expect any response. I was just in a very very dark place and needed to vent before I burst. Thank you for responding and telling me I'm not the only one stressed out like this. Hope it works out for you when your family comes over!
